description: This file defines functions, types, and constants related to resolving and managing boundary paths within a filesystem, including handling symbolic links, path canonicalization, and boundary validation.

methods.name: resolveBoundaryPath
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves a boundary path based on provided parameters, handling symbolic links and boundary validation.

methods.name: resolveBoundaryPathSync
methods.description: Synchronously resolves a boundary path based on provided parameters, handling symbolic links and boundary validation.

methods.name: resolvePathViaExistingAncestor
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves a path by finding an existing ancestor directory and reconstructing the full path.

methods.name: resolvePathViaExistingAncestorSync
methods.description: Synchronously resolves a path by finding an existing ancestor directory and reconstructing the full path.
